episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Therapist Ben Harmon, his wife, Vivien, and their daughter, Violet, move across the country to Los Angeles to escape their troubled past.

episodes.title: Home Invasion
episodes.summary: Serial killer enthusiasts reenact the brutal murders of two nursing students, while Ben returns to Boston to fix a mistake involving an old flame.

episodes.title: Murder House
episodes.summary: Ben confronts Moira about recent strange behavior, while Vivien learns about the house's first resident.

episodes.title: Halloween Part 1
episodes.summary: Two of the house's previous residents, interior designers Chad and Patrick, give the Harmons decorating advice.

episodes.title: Halloween Part 2
episodes.summary: While on a date with Violet, Tate is harassed by a group of bloody teens. Ben and Vivien are haunted by one of the house's newest guests.

episodes.title: Piggy, Piggy
episodes.summary: Ben sees a new patient who is terrified by the legend of a man who slaughters those who repeat a specific mantra into a mirror.

episodes.title: Open House
episodes.summary: Moira persuades a prospective buyer to make an offer, but Constance and Larry try to undermine her efforts. Meanwhile, Vivien and Luke grow closer.

episodes.title: Rubber Man
episodes.summary: The identity of the man in the rubber suit is revealed.

episodes.title: Spooky Little Girl
episodes.summary: One of history's most famous murder victims pays the house a visit. Constance discovers more of Tate's bad behavior.

episodes.title: Smoldering Children
episodes.summary: In 1994, Larry gets burned. In the present, Ben begins to understand what happened to cause Vivien's institutionalization. Constance is questioned by the police in Travis' death. Violet learns something about herself that she doesn't know.

episodes.title: Birth
episodes.summary: Vivien gives birth. Violet learns who fathered one of her new siblings.

episodes.title: Afterbirth
episodes.summary: The aftermath of Vivien's difficult labour is revealed and Ben makes plans to get out of the house. Some of the spirits have other plans and the family has to pull together to make it through these very tough changes.

episodes.title: Welcome to Briarcliff
episodes.summary: After a life-changing experience, a young man is admitted into a notorious insane asylum, while a local reporter is determined to get the full story.

episodes.title: Tricks and Treats
episodes.summary: An exorcist is summoned to Briarcliff to help save a troubled farm boy. Sister Jude's darkest secret is revealed.

episodes.title: Nor'easter
episodes.summary: A group of patients plan an escape from the asylum during a violent storm. Sister Jude is haunted by her past.

episodes.title: I Am Anne Frank Part 1
episodes.summary: A new patient claiming to be Anne Frank exposes Arden's past. Kit learns why Grace was admitted to Briarcliff.

episodes.title: I Am Anne Frank Part 2
episodes.summary: Sister Jude digs up dirt on Arden. Kit makes a surprising confession. Bloody Face is unmasked.

episodes.title: The Origins of Monstrosity
episodes.summary: A mysterious little girl is abandoned at Briarcliff. The Monsignor makes a Faustian pact with Dr. Arden. The origin of Bloody Face is revealed.

episodes.title: Dark Cousin
episodes.summary: Sister Mary Eunice is terrified to discover a dark angel has descended on Briarcliff. Kit makes a bold move to be reunited with Grace.

episodes.title: Unholy Night
episodes.summary: A murderous Santa wreaks havoc on Briarcliff. Sister Jude faces off with the Devil. Arden has a shocking encounter in the Death Chute.

episodes.title: The Coat Hanger
episodes.summary: The Monsignor takes an unlikely convert under his wing. Lana secures a new piece of evidence that can exonerate Kit. Dr. Arden witnesses a miraculous return.

episodes.title: The Name Game
episodes.summary: The Monsignor confronts the Devil. Dr. Arden's experiments reach a shocking conclusion. Dr. Thredson facilitates a surprising reunion for Kit.

episodes.title: Spilt Milk
episodes.summary: Grace brings Kit devastating news about the aliens' experiments on Alma. Dr. Thredson receives an unexpected visitor. The Monsignor goes to extreme lengths to silence Jude.

episodes.title: Continuum
episodes.summary: A deadly new inmate threatens Sister Jude's chance of release from Briarcliff. Grace's obsession with the aliens turns violent.

episodes.title: Madness Ends
episodes.summary: Johnny sets out to complete his father's work. Lana leads the charge to finally shut down Briarcliff.

episodes.title: Bitchcraft
episodes.summary: After discovering her unique bloodline, a young girl is whisked away to a special academy for girls who share the same lineage.

episodes.title: Boy Parts
episodes.summary: Fiona threatens a long-standing peace when she delves into Madame LaLaurie's past, while Zoe and Madison must deal with a horrible tragedy.

episodes.title: The Replacements
episodes.summary: Fiona takes on an unlikely protégé. A guilt-ridden Zoe tries to give Kyle his old life back. Madison has a fiery exchange with Joan Ramsey, a new neighbor.

episodes.title: Fearful Pranks Ensue
episodes.summary: Fiona's choices rattle a decades-long truce between the Salem witches and Marie Laveau. The Council of Witchcraft pays a surprise visit to the Academy with disturbing allegations.

episodes.title: Burn, Witch. Burn!
episodes.summary: Besieged by Marie Laveau's army, Zoe unleashes a new power. Fiona and Myrtle clash over control of the Coven. Madame LaLaurie is confronted by old ghosts.

episodes.title: The Axeman Cometh
episodes.summary: Zoe, Queenie, and Nan make contact with a dark spirit trapped in the Academy. Cordelia's new power brings on a heartbreaking revelation.

episodes.title: The Dead
episodes.summary: Fiona finds new purpose in a dangerous love affair. A night out with LaLaurie leads Queenie to question her place in the Coven. Cordelia makes a fateful decision about her mother.

episodes.title: The Sacred Taking
episodes.summary: Cordelia rallies the girls in the fight to stop Fiona. A dangerous new enemy puts Misty in the crosshairs. The rivalry between Marie Laveau and Delphine comes to a head.

episodes.title: Head
episodes.summary: Cordelia's attacker is revealed. Fiona looks to form an alliance with Marie Laveau. Nan learns a disturbing truth about Luke's past.

episodes.title: The Magical Delights of Stevie Nicks
episodes.summary: Fiona attempts to out the new Supreme with a visit from Stevie Nicks. Cordelia learns the truth about Hank and the Witch Hunters. Madison tries to eliminate her competition for the Supremacy.

episodes.title: Protect the Coven
episodes.summary: Fiona and Laveau have a deadly face off with The Corporation. Cordelia makes a desperate sacrifice to protect the Coven.

episodes.title: Go to Hell
episodes.summary: Cordelia's latest vision puts the Coven's future in question. With the end of Fiona's reign approaching, the girls manifest powerful new gifts. Queenie's search for Marie Laveau leads her to Hell and back.

episodes.title: The Seven Wonders
episodes.summary: A new Supreme rises.

episodes.title: Monsters Among Us
episodes.summary: One of the only surviving sideshows in the country struggles to stay in business during the dawning era of television. When police make a terrifying discovery at a local farmhouse, the eccentric purveyor of the freak show sees an opportunity that will lead her troupe either to their salvation or ruin.

episodes.title: Massacres and Matinees
episodes.summary: A citywide curfew threatens to shut down the Freak Show. A strongman from Ethel's troubled past arrives at camp. Gloria arranges a terrifying play date for Dandy. The Tattler Twins reveal a talent that could knock Elsa from the spotlight.

episodes.title: Edward Mordrake: Part 1
episodes.summary: The Freaks refuse to perform on Halloween due to an old carny superstition. Jimmy is smitten by a woman claiming to be a fortuneteller. Ethel receives life-changing news.

episodes.title: Edward Mordrake: Part 2
episodes.summary: Edward Mordrake continues his search for a Freak to add to his ghostly coterie. Elsa tells the grisly story of her days in Germany. Jimmy and Maggie have a run-in with the Twisted Clown.

episodes.title: Pink Cupcakes
episodes.summary: Stanley and Maggie hatch a plan to murder the Freaks. Gloria hides the evidence of Dandy's gruesome new hobby. A health scare reveals Desiree may not be the oddity she once thought.

episodes.title: Bullseye
episodes.summary: Elsa unveils a dangerous new act. Stanley puts pressure on Maggie to murder Jimmy. Paul indulges in a secret romance.

episodes.title: Test of Strength
episodes.summary: The women of the Freak Show rally against Dell after his latest act of violence. A strange encounter with Dandy raises Jimmy's suspicion about the clown murders.

episodes.title: Blood Bath
episodes.summary: Recent disappearances around camp raise Ethel's suspicion of Elsa. Gloria makes a last ditch effort to contain Dandy's bloodlust.

episodes.title: Tupperware Party Massacre
episodes.summary: In the wake of a tragic loss, Jimmy sinks into a drunken despair. A reading from Maggie spurs Dandy to action. Stanley and Elsa track down the Twins.

episodes.title: Orphans
episodes.summary: The death of a Freak sparks troubling behavior in Pepper. Elsa reveals the history of the Freak Show. Desiree grows suspicious of Maggie.

episodes.title: Magical Thinking
episodes.summary: Elsa prepares for her move to Hollywood. The Twins grow enamored with a traveling salesman. Dell plots Jimmy's escape from police custody.

episodes.title: Show Stoppers
episodes.summary: Dandy gives the Twins troubling information about Chester. Maggie vows to prove her loyalty to Jimmy. The Freaks enforce their harsh code of justice.

episodes.title: Curtain Call
episodes.summary: The Freaks rebel against new management. Dandy prepares for his debut performance. Elsa arrives in Tinseltown.

episodes.title: Checking In
episodes.summary: Detective John Lowe investigates a strange murder-torture case, and gets a tip that leads him to the Hotel Cortez. Meanwhile, the staff and long-time residents discover that the owner has sold the hotel and they will soon be evicted.

episodes.title: Chutes and Ladders
episodes.summary: While Will holds a fashion show in the lobby, his son Lochlin shows Scarlett one of the hotel's many secrets. Meanwhile, John forces Iris to tell him the history of the hotel from the 1920s when it was built as an abbatoir by a homicidal oil man.

episodes.title: Mommy
episodes.summary: After a family counseling session, Alex gives John some bad news. Meanwhile, Donovan tells his mother to kill herself and then is captured by the Countess' rival.

episodes.title: Devil's Night
episodes.summary: James holds his annual dinner for his most favored students, and John discovers that he's on the list. Meanwhile, Alex confronts the Countess over the changes in Holden, and the older woman tells her how she can be with her son forever.

episodes.title: Room Service
episodes.summary: To save a dying boy, Alex uses her own blood with unexpected consequences. Meanwhile, Iris and Liz draw closer, Donovan makes a deal with Ramona, and John wakes up in bed with Sally.

episodes.title: Room 33
episodes.summary: Iris looks the other way as Ramona and Donovan enter the Cortez to deprive the Countess of what she loves most. Meanwhile, Liz finds true love but there's a snag, and John inadvertently brings a horror into his house.

episodes.title: Flicker
episodes.summary: The Countess' first love is revealed in 1925, while two modern-day construction workers open up a wing of the Cortez that has not been seen... since 1925. Meanwhile, John checks himself into the hospital to confront the suspect in the Ten Commandment killings.

episodes.title: The Ten Commandments Killer
episodes.summary: John and Hahn meet over Wren's body, and John tells his former partner who the Ten Commandments Killer really is.

episodes.title: She Wants Revenge
episodes.summary: Donovan asks the Countess to commit to him totally... and then goes to Ramona and offers to betray his lover. Meanwhile, Iris kills two more people in the Cortez, and Will makes his wedding plans.

episodes.title: She Gets Revenge
episodes.summary: Liz and Iris decide to make a clean exit from the Cortez, but a visit by Liz's son Douglas causes a change in plans. Meanwhile, John and Alex decide to give their marriage a second chance, and Donavan confronts Rudolph.

episodes.title: Battle Royale
episodes.summary: John brings his family home, but Sally has other plans. Meanwhile, Liz and Iris help Ramona escape her prison and provide her with the blood she needs.to restore herself to health.

episodes.title: Be Our Guest
episodes.summary: The last days of the Cortez are chronicled as Liz and Iris take charge and put an end to the killing. Meanwhile, John speaks for the first time with a psychic to reveal his fate and the fate of his family.

episodes.title: Chapter 1
episodes.summary: A young interracial couple move into a farmhouse in North Carolina after purchasing it with their life savings. However, unearthly phenomena begin occurring and things are not what they seem.

episodes.title: Chapter 2
episodes.summary: Matt and Shelby find a revealing videotape in a hidden cellar. Meanwhile, Lee's daughter Flora makes a new friend, and the mysterious events continue.

episodes.title: Chapter 3
episodes.summary: Lee and the others conduct a frantic search for the missing Flora, but a psychic is the only one who offers her hope of finding her daughter. Meanwhile, the identity of the Butcher is revealed.

episodes.title: Chapter 4
episodes.summary: Scathach presents herself for the first time and reveals what she wants. However, Thomasin and the ghost settlers have other plans.

episodes.title: Chapter 5
episodes.summary: The Millers attempt to escape the house with the help of an unexpected ally, but fall into the clutches of the Polk family.

episodes.title: Chapter 6
episodes.summary: The producer of My Roanoke Nightmare decides to follow up his huge hit with a second season... putting the actors and their real-life counterparts in the same house during the Blood Moon, and seeing if Lee confesses to Mason's murder.

episodes.title: Chapter 7
episodes.summary: Chaos breaks out at the house as Audrey, Monet, and Lee try to escape through the secret tunnel. Meanwhile, Shelby learns why Matt came back to the house, and Agnes considers a career change.

episodes.title: Chapter 8
episodes.summary: Lee, Audrey, and Monet try to escape the Polks. Meanwhile, Shelby and Dominic are trapped by the ghosts in the house.

episodes.title: Chapter 9
episodes.summary: Three My Roanoke Nightmare fans pay a visit to the House, unaware that they've arrived at the worst possible time. Meanwhile, Lee and Audrey try to recover the camera, and a new visitor doesn't prove very helpful.

episodes.title: Chapter 10
episodes.summary: After Three Days in Hell, Lee stands trial for murder and is then interviewed by Lana Winters.

episodes.title: Election Night
episodes.summary: After Trump is elected President, Ally Mayfair-Richards is beset by all of her old phobias... and they appear to be coming to life.

episodes.title: Don't Be Afraid of the Dark
episodes.summary: Kai runs for City Council, and pays a visit to Ally. Meanwhile, Ivy asks Rudy to pay Ally a visit, and Ally and ivy visit their new neighbors.

episodes.title: Neighbors from Hell
episodes.summary: The community turns on Ally after she shoots and kills a Hispanic man. At home tensions between Ally and Ivy grow worse, and Kai may be Ally's only hope.
The events surrounding the 2017 Presidential election as Kai begins to gather his cult.

episodes.title: Holes
episodes.summary: Kai asks for the cult members to prove their loyalty against one of their own. Meanwhile, Ally meets with Rudy to tell him about her problems dealing with Ivy's departure.

episodes.title: Mid-Western Assassin
episodes.summary: Ally takes Meadow to Rudy in the hopes that she will confirm her story about the cult. However, Meadow has a change of heart. Meanwhile, an unexpected opponent runs against Kai in the city council election.

episodes.title: Valerie Solanas Died for Your Sins: Scumbag
episodes.summary: Kai begins to solidify his grasp on power after winning the election, and a mysterious woman warns Beverly, Ivy, and Winter that Kai will soon cast them aside.

episodes.title: Winter of Our Discontent
episodes.summary: Kai gains a new ally as he seeks out the betrayers in his cult... and asks Winter to become the mother of the messiah.

episodes.title: Drink the Kool-Aid
episodes.summary: Kai tests the loyalty of his followers, including the women. Meanwhile, Ally tells Ivy how she overcame her phobias, and plots to take Oz away.

episodes.title: Charles (Manson) in Charge
episodes.summary: Kai receives visits from Charles Manson as he begins to question everyone around him.

episodes.title: Great Again
episodes.summary: The FBI arrest Kai, but he continues to amass power in prison. Meanwhile, Ally tries to move on with her life but decides to go into politics.

episodes.title: The End
episodes.summary: The end of the world happens when the bombs drop, and the survivors wonder if surviving is worth it after the Cooperative gives them shelter.

episodes.title: The Morning After
episodes.summary: Michael determines which of the survivors are worth taking to Sanctuary, and a familiar body appears from the past to seduce Gallant.

episodes.title: Forbidden Fruit
episodes.summary: When a carriage with a box of apples arrive, Wilhelmina decides to throw a Halloween party. Three guests crash the afterparty.

episodes.title: Could It Be ... Satan?
episodes.summary: Michael's early life as a teenager, and how he came to find himself at the Hawthorne Academy, is revealed.

episodes.title: Boy Wonder
episodes.summary: Cordelia not only challenges Michael to complete the Seven Wonders, but to surpass his predecessors by bringing Misty Day back from Purgatory. Meanwhile, John Henry has suspicions about Michael's background and Miriam has a chat with him.

episodes.title: Return to Murder House
episodes.summary: Old spirits rise and are laid to rest as Madison and Behold come to the Murder House seeking answers to Michael's childhood.

episodes.title: Traitor
episodes.summary: Cordelia takes steps to punish the traitors among the coven and stop Michael from rising to power as the Antichrist.

episodes.title: Sojourn
episodes.summary: Michael questions his father's unholy plan for world annihilation, and is directed on the proper path to recover Miriam.

episodes.title: Fire and Reign
episodes.summary: Michael strikes at the school, but Cordelia, Myrtle, and Mallory escape him. Mutt and Jeff step in to guide Michael to his destiny, and recruit Wilhelmina to administer the Outposts.

episodes.title: Apocalypse Then
episodes.summary: The surviving witches travel to Outpost 3 to stand in final battle against the Antichrist.

episodes.title: Camp Redwood
episodes.summary: The notorious Mr. Jingles brutally kills nine camp residents in 1970. Fourteen years later, Jingles escapes the insane asylum where he was confined and returns to the camp to wreck bloody havoc.

episodes.title: Mr. Jingles
episodes.summary: Margaret makes contact with one of the killers, and Brooke tells Montana about her tragic backstory. Xavier meets the man who called him earlier, and Trevor takes a shower.

episodes.title: Slashdance
episodes.summary: The dark pasts of three of the camp staff are revealed. Ray panics and loses his head, the camp nurse ends up paddled, and Chet gets the point.

episodes.title: True Killers
episodes.summary: As the counselors try to escape Camp Redwood, Jingles meets an old friend and Margaret prays to God for strength.

episodes.title: Red Dawn
episodes.summary: Brooke fights for her life inside a thriller, Xavier goes after Jingles, Margaret takes Chet on a boat trip, and Don gets ahead.

episodes.title: Episode 100
episodes.summary: After Brooke is arrested for multiple murders, the spirits at the camp settle into a life of dull, boring, murderous routine. Margaret makes a killing in macabre real estate, Trevor becomes a kept man, Richard goes to prison, and Jingles makes a new life for himself.

episodes.title: The Lady in White
episodes.summary: On their way to Redwood, Rita and Brooke give a man a lift. Jingles meets his mother for the first time since the 1950s, and Richard cuts his way into the musical festival.

episodes.title: Rest in Pieces
episodes.summary: Richard arrives at Redwood and finds two allies to help him in his battle against Jingles. Montana and Trevor are reunited, and Brooke and Donna reach their destination.

episodes.title: Final Girl
episodes.summary: Jingles' son comes to Redwood looking for closure, and learns the fate of his father and his victims.

episodes.title: Cape Fear
episodes.summary: A struggling writer, his pregnant wife, and their daughter move to an isolated beach town for the winter. Once they're settled in, the town's true residents begin to make themselves known.

episodes.title: Pale
episodes.summary: A quick fix for Harry's writer's block has unexpected side effects. Two eccentric locals offer Harry a helping hand.

episodes.title: Thirst
episodes.summary: Harry's newfound talent brings an unexpected visitor to town. Alma decides to take matters into her own hands.

episodes.title: Blood Buffet
episodes.summary: The dark history of Provincetown and its residents are brought to light.

episodes.title: Gaslight
episodes.summary: Harry struggles to keep Alma under control. Doris is pushed past her limits.

episodes.title: Winter Kills
episodes.summary: Ursula devises a sinister plan. The Gardners write their final act.

episodes.title: Take Me to Your Leader
episodes.summary: A group of college students on a camping trip are swept up in a horrifying and deadly conspiracy decades in the making.

episodes.title: Inside
episodes.summary: The President struggles with the morality of a deal he must make.

episodes.title: Blue Moon
episodes.summary: An unexpected visitor arrives at the White House and reveals the details of the horrific plan.

episodes.title: The Future Perfect
episodes.summary: Mamie takes matters into her own hands. The fate of the future is revealed.

episodes.title: Something's Coming
episodes.summary: Mysterious deaths and disappearances ramp up in the city. A doctor makes a frightening discovery, and a local reporter becomes tomorrow's headline.

episodes.title: Thank You for Your Service
episodes.summary: Without the NYPD's help, Gino is forced to get resourceful. A traumatizing event brings dangerous suspects closer than ever.

episodes.title: Smoke Signals
episodes.summary: Without the NYPD's help, Gino is forced to get resourceful; a traumatizing event brings dangerous suspects closer than ever.

episodes.title: Black Out
episodes.summary: As darkness consumes the city, evil takes root in the unlikeliest of places.

episodes.title: Bad Fortune
episodes.summary: Hannah receives concerning news while Patrick suffers a loss; the city's most dangerous resident reveals his true motives.

episodes.title: The Body
episodes.summary: A chilling event from Patrick's past returns to haunt him; Gino and Henry are determined to uncover it at any cost.

episodes.title: The Sentinel
episodes.summary: Patrick's search reaches an epic conclusion. The group reshifts their focus, but a different plan is in store for Hannah.

episodes.title: Fire Island
episodes.summary: Terrifying events at Fire Island rupture the group and force them to reconsider everything.

episodes.title: Requiem 1981/1987 Part One
episodes.summary: As vitality expires, two old friends are led through uniques journeys of retrospection.

episodes.title: Requiem 1981/1987 Part Two
episodes.summary: Grief and peril dominate Gino; the discovery of a tragedy becomes a revelation for Adam.

episodes.title: Multiply Thy Pain
episodes.summary: After multiple failed attempts of IVF, actress Anna Victoria Alcott wants nothing more than to start a family. As the buzz around her recent film grows, she fears that something may be targeting her - and her pursuit of motherhood.

episodes.title: Rockabye
episodes.summary: It's awards season and Anna is primed to be a major player in contention. After a frightening encounter convinces her that she's being followed, she begins to question who she can trust.

episodes.title: When the Bough Breaks
episodes.summary: As Anna and Dex settle into their Hamptons sanctuary, the comfort begins to fade. Her circle of trust is slowly shrinking, and doubt creeps into Anna's head - could the evil be right under her nose?

episodes.title: Vanishing Twin
episodes.summary: With help from Siobhan, a major announcement helps restore Anna's public image. Behind closed doors however, something powerful seems to be taking over.

episodes.title: Preech
episodes.summary: Anna senses the dark presence closing in on her, closer than ever. Ms. Preecher reveals pieces of her past and may know the truth about what's happening to Anna and Dex.

episodes.title: Opening Night
episodes.summary: A glimpse into Anna's past reveals why she craves motherhood, while Dex's troubling family life is dragged into the spotlight.

episodes.title: Ave Hestia
episodes.summary: Entrenched in her grapple for fame and motherhood, Anna may be involved in a cycle much bigger - and older - than she realizes.

episodes.title: Little Gold Man
episodes.summary: The world around Anna is starting to crescendo in every way: her career path continues to skyrocket, while her personal life is more stressful than ever - just in time for Hollywood's big night.

episodes.title: The Auteur
episodes.summary: Her choices have unknowingly led to deadly consequences, but Anna can still have it all - for a price.
After a near-death experience, Ben provides hospice care for a mysterious client in an eerie penthouse.

episodes.title: 1:13 AM
episodes.summary: Ben struggles with some unusual hospice duties and learns how the job vacancy actually happened.

episodes.title: Rauhnacht
episodes.summary: While hosting a holiday party, Constance deals carefully with two surprise guests, all to keep the special night on course.

episodes.title: Is That All There Is?
episodes.summary: As Constance's evening winds down, the holiday guests have dark places to go and people to see.

episodes.title: Date Night
episodes.summary: A friend of Ben's girlfriend wants to reconnect, whether he is ready to face the past or not.

episodes.title: The Return of Devil's Night
episodes.summary: As an unseen threat closes in, the witches of Miss Robichaux's Academy turn to powers older than the school itself.
